description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח מכלול
description.summary: This table outlines conditions related to policy cancellation due to changes in the insured's condition. It details scenarios where the insurer's obligation to pay benefits is reduced or voided, and the conditions under which refunds may be issued.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת תנאים הקשורים לביטול הפוליסה עקב שינויים במצבו של המבוטח. היא מפרטת תרחישים שבהם חובת התשלום של המבטח מופחתת או מבוטלת, והתנאים שבהם ניתן להחזר כספי. הטבלה רלוונטית לפוליסת ביטוח מכלול. בפרט, היא מתייחסת לתגובה או היעדר הודעה, כוונת זדון, והערכה של מבטח סביר. המבטח יהיה פטור לחלוטין במקרים של כוונה הונאה או אם מבטח סביר לא היה נכנס לפוליסה מלכתחילה.

description.column_axis: Details of the condition and its consequences

2.7 If an insured event occurs prior to the contract being cancelled by virtue of this paragraph 2, the insurer shall only be obliged to pay proportionately reduced insurance benefits, according to the ratio between the insurance fees which would
have been customarily paid by it according to the actual condition and the agreed insurance fees. It shall be completely exempt upon each of the following:
2.7.1 The response or lack of notice as noted in condition 2.4 (as the case may be) were given with fraudulent intent.
2.7.2 A reasonable insurer would not have entered into the policy, even for increased insurance fees, had it been aware of the actual condition following the change. In such instance, the insured will be entitled to a refund of the insurance fees paid by it for the period after the change.

This table outlines conditions related to policy cancellation due to changes in the insured's condition. It details scenarios where the insurer's obligation to pay benefits is reduced or voided, and the conditions under which refunds may be issued. בין הערכים בטבלה: fraudulent intent: applies; reasonable insurer: not enter policy; refund of fees: after change; incomplete/untruthful response: applies.
